profile.playerNamesHint: Games are matched by these names (either colour, case-insensitive) as the student profile's input. Professional games are excluded by default; mark them manually in the library.

privacy.telemetryHint: Off by default. Crashes and feature counts only — never game records, chat, or keys.
privacy.debugHint: Turn this on when investigating a problem. Logs stay on this machine.

encryptionUnavailable.title: The key cannot be stored securely
encryptionUnavailable.body: This machine offers no system encrypted storage, so the key lasts only for this session and must be entered again after a restart.

about.telemetryConsentHint: Off by default. When on, crash dumps and a few anonymous events (version, engine start — scalars only) are written to a local directory — never sent over the network, and never containing games, chats, or anything you type. See what was collected any time via Help → Reveal Crash Reports. Takes effect on next launch.

state.downloaded: Version {{version}} is ready — it installs when you quit
state.disabled: Auto-update is unavailable here (unpackaged dev build, disabled in settings, or the unsigned macOS build)
